outputs.name: default
outputs.description: The default Playwright test configuration for the provider-picker suite: tests in ../../tests/e2e matching provider-picker.spec.ts, one worker, the list reporter, and a 900 by 900 viewport with baseURL HARNESS_PICKER_PREVIEW_URL or http://127.0.0.1:<port>. The port is HARNESS_PICKER_PREVIEW_PORT or 47839; under HARNESS_VERIFY an unset port is replaced by a free one and written back to that variable for the run's workers. Unless HARNESS_PICKER_PREVIEW_URL is set, a webServer run from the repository root builds the picker, clears .cache/codex-picker-preview and starts codex picker-preview on that port, waits up to 180 s for <origin>/preview, and reuses a running server except under HARNESS_VERIFY.
